rationale: Build toolchain pins only. tools/toolchain/manifest.toml moves Xcode to 27.2 (27B52), pins the golden's macOS base by digest and pins ccache and git-lfs in the mise lock; check_env.py gains an Xcode version+build check and ccache/git-lfs checks (warn mode on CI legs); tart-provision.sh and mise-golden-layer.sh read and enforce the same pins at bake time. No golden is rebaked by this change, and no design-import, Chromium, rendering or packaging authority moves.
